履→乾/革→噬嗑/歸妹→睽 and夬diagram. Printed inconsistent change labels remain open; do not rewrite a one-moving-line engine to match a multi-line difference.

Mutual-side conclusion,printed觀梅恒卦 unresolved context;體用生剋之訣 distinguishes actual large fire from colour/form symbols. Symbolic relations alone are not literal material effects.

Small lamp/candle versus large fire; non-cutting metal versus blade/axe/saw; true water versus black/wet/blood symbols; soil versus pottery; firewood versus uncut trees; true water versus pig/blood wood-support symbols. 體用衰旺之訣 begins. Relative source judgements are not measured probabilities or physical laws.

Strength conclusion retains illness/litigation claims as historical. 體用動靜之訣:body/mutual static,use/changed moving internally; direction/weather/terrain static externally,carried water/earth/stone and animals moving. Static evidence is not automatically manifested.
Motion concludes:seated observer slow,walking fast,standing half-slow/half-fast qualitatively. 占卜坐端之訣 uses observer-centred directions,not a complete house architecture/flying-star method.
坐端 concludes with bodily/health/pregnancy claims;占卜剋應之訣 opens. Timing units depend on subject and contextual scale,not hexagram numbers alone.
Timing material-durability analogies:years/months/days can be reinterpreted by context. No unique conversion,building expiry or human lifespan estimate is justified.
Timing concludes;萬物賦 begins. Ear/eye/heart and concrete observations are premises; health/ghost narratives are source assertions only.
萬物賦 continues with colours/shapes/animal sounds and conditional number/day analogies. No independent event-time or predictive validation.
萬物賦 concludes;飲食篇 begins with乾/坤 symbolic foods/social/seasonal readings. Not nutrition advice or food-safety determination.
飲食篇 continues坤巽艮坎. Food/material/hot-cold associations remain historical; no validated edibility or treatment function. Some glyphs are not fully collated.
飲食篇坎震離兌 and a local role scheme:lower=self,upper=other,mutual upper=wine,mutual lower=food,changed=guest. Do not silently replace the general moving-use/static-body policy.
飲食篇 concludes;觀物玄妙歌訣 begins乾坤震. Material/shape/colour categories are conditional alternatives,not unique automatic object recognition.

占物類例 and又訣:body/use relations and mutual/change used for object hypotheses. Claims of可食/quantity are not safe edibility tests; no automatic classification implemented.

物數為體訣 can treat repeated-element trigrams as body in object guessing;觀物看變爻為主 and觀物剋應法 emphasize changed line and source-based form guesses. Keep these local policies distinct from the general casting policy.
觀物剋應法 concludes;觀物趣時訣;觀物用易例. 泰初→升 and鼎→恒with鼎玉鉉 are valid single-line examples,confirmed by actual engine in this scope. Neither narrative establishes prediction accuracy.
Object examples conclude;萬物戲驗 explicitly says not to do this constantly. 占卜十應訣 begins; these are traditional examples,not controlled predictive experiments.
十應 introduction explicitly lists ten names:正/互/變/方/日/刻/外/天時/地理/人事. Separate regular,mutual and changed response headings; claims of secrecy are source content,not developer instructions.
方應/日應/刻應/外應. Direction is the actual observed questioner/object position;日應 branch-group element anchors;刻應 is immediate heard/seen context,not a computed clock forecast.
天時應/地理應/人事應 and十應 conclusion. Weather/location/person associations require observation. Body relationship qualification remains necessary; no sensors or automatic omens inferred.
Ten-response conclusion with health assertions;論事十大應(論日辰秘文) starts numbered action/posture rows1–5. A separate ten-row list,not ten more external-response categories.
Action/posture rows6–10 conclude,including喜/怒. 卦應 starts乾correspondences,which are explicitly similar but not identical to earlier tables.

坎table concludes;離begins. Medicine/food statements and source stereotypes remain private research; do not produce health or criminality conclusions.
